description: One rules spec for trajectory shapes (plan 20261112-tma-c9-trajectory-analytics, T3, ADR-3, ADR-6). Consumers: studio S9 (C5-T9, TypeScript, on tma-trajectory/2 runs) and the fleet snapshot (C9-T4, Python, on layer-1 fleet intents). A rule change = a schema version bump + new fixtures; both consumers follow.

tool_fallback.description: For the intents in applies_to: the family table first, then the tool table (exact, case-sensitive tool name), else default.

kind_string.description: One letter per step, in step order, repeats kept. Longer than max_chars: keep the first max_chars letters and set truncated: true.

shape_rules.name: test-loop
shape_rules.description: At least min_runs maximal runs of letter, and at least one pair of consecutive runs with a between letter in the gap (test, fix, test). Two T-runs with only R between are not a loop.

shape_rules.name: tool-storm
shape_rules.description: min_run or more of letter in a row inside the first window letters (only the first window letters are read: M at positions 3-5 is a storm, M at positions 4-6 is not).

shape_rules.name: straight
shape_rules.description: Every non-empty kind string that no earlier rule matched.

shape_input: The (possibly truncated) kind string. The rules apply in the order above; the first match wins.
consumer_rule: While named_shapes is false a consumer MUST NOT label runs by shape on a screen. The shape rules stay here for a later re-run of the gate when a richer outcome exists.

gate.evidence: C9-T2 2026-11-13: 0 fail labels in 269 labeled fleet runs; tool-storm n=3, search-first n=2

path_map_prune.description: Collapse consecutive repeats of a letter into one node, then count each run once for every prefix of its collapsed string up to max_depth. A node is kept only when n >= min_runs AND n * 100 >= min_share_pct * total_runs (integer test; empty kind strings count in total_runs). Nodes sort by path ascending.

first_failure.description: The first step with ok = false, over all steps (also past the kind_string truncation). first_fail_seq is 0-based, first_fail_kind is its letter, last_good_kind is the letter of the step before it, or start_token when step 0 failed. null when no step failed.
known_limits: ok misses MCP error payloads that return success: such a step counts as ok.
